title: Dubu Jorim (Korean Braised Tofu)
summary: Golden pan-fried tofu gently braised in a savory, mildly spicy Korean soy-chili sauce with onion and scallion.

steps.description: Slice 400g firm tofu into roughly 1.5cm-thick pieces and pat dry thoroughly. Thinly slice 1/2 onion and finely slice 1/2 scallion.
Mix 120ml water, 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp gochugaru, 1 tsp minced garlic, and 1 tsp sugar in a small bowl.
Heat 2 tbsp neutral oil in a wide skillet over medium heat. Add tofu in one layer and pan-fry for 2–3 minutes per side until golden.
Add the onion around the tofu and pour the seasoning liquid over it. Reduce to medium-low, cover loosely, and simmer for 5 minutes, gently shaking the skillet to prevent sticking.
Add the scallion and simmer for another 2–3 minutes until a little sauce remains. Turn off the heat, drizzle with 1 tsp toasted sesame oil, and optionally sprinkle with 1 tsp sesame seeds.
